lines.text: Hello, have a seat. What happened?
I turned my right ankle on Tuesday night and I'm coming in with it still really swollen.
Not a hundred percent on the day though, could've been Wednesday.
Could you put weight on it straight after?
I hobbled off the court on my own, yeah.
Let me have a look. There's bruising on the outside and it's tender just in front of the ankle bone, not on the bone itself.
I think you have a sprained ligament on the outside of the ankle, probably a moderate one, though I'd want to see it again in a week to be sure.
For the pain you can take ibuprofen 400 milligrams three times a day after food, for up to five days.
Keep it raised on a cushion in the evenings, above the level of your hip.
No running for two weeks, but walking is fine.
